EC's RTI response on 'SIR' decision sparks questions

The Election Commission of India (EC) has stated that no nationwide decision was taken regarding 'SIR' in 2025, according to an RTI response. This statement has raised questions about who made the decision for a nationwide 'SIR', as reported by The News Minute. Mathrubhumi English also noted the EC's clarification that no nationwide decision was taken in 2025.
